description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用不同素材，納入多元教學活動， 協助學生理解、賞析文本，建構自己的觀點，並與同儕分享、交流，以培養英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的基礎技能。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels. Different materials and diverse teaching activities were incorporated into course design to help students comprehend and appreciate texts, construct their own viewpoints, and communicate with their peers in order to develop basic skills in reading, speaking, and listening in English.

targets.describe_ch: 找到多元學習素材之主題，理解內容大意、分析重要細節及邏輯相關性。
targets.describe_en: In regard to the multiple learning materials, students can identify topics and themes, comprehend gist, and analyze important details and their logical relevance.

targets.describe_ch: 針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
targets.describe_en: Students can effectively express their opinions on the themes of learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives and learn to cooperate with other people in teams.

Notification:
1. Please turn in your assignment on time. No late assignment/homework will be accepted.
2. Make-up quiz or exam score is 80% of the original score, so the highest score you can possibly get for a make-up quiz or exam is 80.  
3. About making up for the quizzes you missed: You can make up for the class quizzes you missed twice per semester. However, you need to have the leave of absence request on record to be able to make up for the quizzes. In other words, you can’t make up for the quiz you missed if you are late for the class or absent from the class without a leave.

5. You will fail this course if you miss 12 classes or more, including both absence (缺課) and leave of absence (請假).

期中/期末考學生請假補考說明

逢甲大學學則
第二十六條 學生考核請假獲准之補考規定如下：

一、學生因故不能參加各項考核者，須依逢甲大學學生請假辦法完成請假程序，經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。相關規定如下；
(一) 若補考未到者，不得再行補考；但因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病或其他重大事故，持有證明經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。
(二) 學生須在該科考核結束後三日內完成請假程序。

二、學生因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病 (COVID-19不算重大疾病)、依法得申請之公假或公務不能參加各項考核者，需檢具區域級以上醫院或分設診所之診斷證明書、喪假證明文件、依法得申請公假之證明文件，或有關單位主管簽證，並依逢甲大學學生請假辦法之規定，完成請假程序，經核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜，其補考成績以實得分數計。

註：若學生請假原因非本校學則第二十六條所列，外語教學中心決議其補考成績為實得分數打八折計。
Make-up Exam Policy for Students with Approved Leave (Midterm/Final Exam)
Article 26 The rules for students obtaining leave and permission to take make-up examinations are as follows:

1. Students who cannot participate in assessments for any reason must complete the procedures for leave per the University's regulations on leaves of absence for students, and have their make-up examinations handled by the instructor once the instructor approves. The regulations are as follows:
(1) If a student fails to take a make-up examination, he/she will not be allowed to retake a make-up examination; however, for students who cannot take a make-up examination due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or other major accidents, they are to provide certification. The instructor will handle their second make-up examination once the instructor approves.
(2) Leave procedures must be completed within three days after the end of the course assessment.

2. If a student is unable to participate in any assessment due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or official leave that can be applied for by law or official duties, he/she must present a certificate of diagnosis from a hospital at or above the regional level or an associated clinic, a certificate of bereavement, a certificate of application for official leave that can be applied for by law, or a visa issued by the supervisor of the unit in charge, and then complete leave procedures in accordance with the University's regulations on students' obtaining leaves. Once their leave is approved, the instructor will conduct a make-up examination. The grade of the make-up examination is to be based on the actual score.

Note: If a student's reason for taking leave is not included under Article 26 of the University Regulations, the Foreign Language Center has decided that the student's make-up exam score will be calculated at 80% of the actual score obtained.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1. Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data.學生在學術活動中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。
2. Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism.抄襲：必須適當引用來源。未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。
3. Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating.考試作弊：必須遵守考試規則，禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。
4. 考核時如果您抄襲他人的答案、或交作業時您交出全部或部分由他人撰寫的論文或作業，則被視為作弊。
  1. 設計降低作弊的評量方式：
    • 運用真實評量（如，使用可用於其他/實際目的的作業的真實數據）、多階段評量（個人書面然後口頭）、個人反思等，提出需要更高層次思維的問題，這使作弊更難。
    • 多元評量、分散評量權重。
  2. 課程中每種類型的評分作業，要解釋允許和不允許合作、或接受外部協助的內容。
  3. 解釋學生在提交評分作業時，要確認合作、或協助的程序。作為授課教師，請善用校園內外已獲授權使用之圖書或軟體資源；您可以選擇學生接受或不接受幫助的行為，但務必為學生提供報告協作和幫助的方法。
  4. 建議教師制定課程的學術誠信規則時，得參酌：
    • 制定關於學生是否可以使用輔助工具、或就問題集與其他人討論的規則。
    • 說明學生是否可以獲得書面工作的編輯或其他幫助。
    • 在分配小組工作時，為可接受的協作，提供參數。
    • 若有作業報告，善用抄襲比對系統(如圖書館Turnitin)，宣告抄襲比例原則。

4. 考核時如果您抄襲他人的答案、或交作業時您交出全部或部分由他人撰寫的論文或作業，則被視為作弊。
  1. 設計降低作弊的評量方式：
    • 運用真實評量（如，使用可用於其他/實際目的的作業的真實數據）、多階段評量（個人書面然後口頭）、個人反思等，提出需要更高層次思維的問題，這使作弊更難。
    • 多元評量、分散評量權重。
  2. 課程中每種類型的評分作業，要解釋允許和不允許合作、或接受外部協助的內容。
  3. 解釋學生在提交評分作業時，要確認合作、或協助的程序。作為授課教師，請善用校園內外已獲授權使用之圖書或軟體資源；您可以選擇學生接受或不接受幫助的行為，但務必為學生提供報告協作和幫助的方法。
  4. 建議教師制定課程的學術誠信規則時，得參酌：
    • 制定關於學生是否可以使用輔助工具、或就問題集與其他人討論的規則。
    • 說明學生是否可以獲得書面工作的編輯或其他幫助。
    • 在分配小組工作時，為可接受的協作，提供參數。
    • 若有作業報告，善用抄襲比對系統(如圖書館Turnitin)，宣告抄襲比例原則。

courseBankC.describe_ch: 找到多元學習素材之主題，理解內容大意、分析重要細節及邏輯相關性。
courseBankC.describe_en: In regard to the multiple learning materials, students can identify topics and themes, comprehend gist, and analyze important details and their logical relevance.
courseBankC.core_item: 知識探索：能培養多元領域學習的興趣；能統整跨領域的知識；能持續從事跨領域的學習。
courseBankC.core_eng: Knowledge Pursuit：To integrate extensive interests, curiosities and literacy of multidisciplinary knowledge and internalize one’s won viewpoints.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
courseBankC.describe_en: Students can effectively express their opinions on the themes of learning materials and communicate with others effectively.
courseBankC.core_item: 溝通技巧：能具備清楚表達的能力；能理解他人口語與非口語的訊息；能建立良好的人際關係。
courseBankC.core_eng: Communication Skills：To be equipped with the skills of effective verbal and non-verbal  interaction  and team work communication.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。
courseBankC.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives and learn to cooperate with other people in teams.
courseBankC.core_item: 價值判斷：能尊重多元價值；能進行價值的反思；能提出個人的價值判斷。
courseBankC.core_eng: Critical Thinking：To be equipped with multiple perspectives and tolerance of differences to identify problems, engage in reflective and critical thinking to resolutions.
